state.interpretation: Substantive product scaffold with database/server infrastructure implemented, but large portions of application behavior and testing remain explicitly unchecked.

evidence.statement: The repository defines a typed web application stack with React/Vite/server bundling, Drizzle migrations, Vitest, and server-side tRPC structure.
evidence.limits: Presence of tooling does not establish that the unimplemented phases are complete.

evidence.statement: todo.md marks core database schema items and server-side infrastructure such as DB helpers, tRPC routers, trust-signal calculation, RSVP validation, and seeded Selection Engine functions as complete.
evidence.limits: Checked boxes are project-maintained implementation assertions; no CI run was independently established in this review.

evidence.statement: todo.md leaves authentication, community/activity flows, discovery ranking, UI phases, realtime, admin tooling, testing, performance, documentation, security audit, and production launch items largely unchecked.
evidence.limits: Task lists can lag implementation; this is evidence of documented incompleteness, not proof every unchecked item is absent.

evidence.statement: The reusable UWS value is limited at present to server-side state-machine/seeded-selection patterns, not the unfinished social product surface.
evidence.limits: Requires direct code tests before reuse.

suggestions: Do not promote the Q-value framework or ranking weights as validated decision mechanisms merely because they exist in the scaffold.
Inspect the completed RSVP and Selection Engine implementations before any extraction into UWS.
unknowns: Actual coverage of the claimed completed server logic.
Whether Vitest suites exist and pass on current main.

relationships.notes: Potential source of state-machine/reproducible selection patterns only; broad product architecture is not a UWS reuse candidate yet.

verification.reproducibility: Implementation and tests need direct inspection; current review is structural D2.
falsifiers: Direct inspection shows core server mechanisms are absent or non-deterministic.
Current CI/test evidence demonstrates broader completed behavior than the TODO state indicates, changing the review depth.

next_test: Inspect the implemented RSVP state machine and seeded Selection Engine, then run focused tests or CI evidence before recording any reusable primitive.
